## Load and subset physiology data

```{r load-and-subset}
# Read the publication-ready physiology dataset
A17_sunn_phys <- read.csv(
  here("Data", "data_for_publication", "Trait_A17_sunn.csv")
)

# Subset to A17 and sunn lines only
A17_sunn_phys <- A17_sunn_phys[
  A17_sunn_phys$Line %in% c("A17", "sunn"),
]
```

```{r function-for-boxplot-with-tukey-threeway}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rlang)

plot_trait_box_tukey_threeway <- function(data,
                                          trait,
                                          nitrogen_levels = c(5, 20),
                                          ylab = NULL,
                                          remove_outliers = FALSE,
                                          outlier_coef = 1.5) {
  trait_quo <- rlang::ensym(trait)
  trait_chr <- rlang::as_string(trait_quo)
  line_facet_labeller <- as_labeller(
    c(A17 = "bold('A17')", sunn = "italic('sunn-1')"),
    default = label_parsed
  )

  df <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!trait_quo)) %>%
    mutate(
      Nitrogen_mM = as.numeric(as.character(Nitrogen)),
      Nitrogen_f = factor(Nitrogen_mM, levels = nitrogen_levels),
      Line = factor(Line),
      CO2 = factor(CO2, levels = c("AC", "EC"))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      Nitrogen_mM %in% nitrogen_levels,
      is.finite(.data[[trait_chr]]),
      !is.na(Nitrogen_f),
      !is.na(Line),
      !is.na(CO2)
    ) %>%
    mutate(Treatment = interaction(Line, Nitrogen_f, CO2, sep = "_", drop = TRUE))

  if (is.null(ylab)) ylab <- trait_chr
  nitrogen_label <- paste(format(nitrogen_levels, trim = TRUE, drop0trailing = TRUE), collapse = ", ")

  if (remove_outliers) {
    n_before <- nrow(df)

    df <- df %>%
      group_by(Line, CO2, Nitrogen_f) %>%
      mutate(
        Q1 = quantile(.data[[trait_chr]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q3 = quantile(.data[[trait_chr]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_val = IQR(.data[[trait_chr]], na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      filter(
        .data[[trait_chr]] >= Q1 - outlier_coef * IQR_val,
        .data[[trait_chr]] <= Q3 + outlier_coef * IQR_val
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-Q1, -Q3, -IQR_val) %>%
      ungroup()

    cat("\n## ", ylab, " outlier removal - removed ", n_before - nrow(df), " samples by ",
        outlier_coef, " x IQR within Line x CO2 x Nitrogen\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  y_range <- range(df[[trait_chr]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_offset <- if (diff(y_range) == 0) max(abs(y_range), 1) * 0.08 else diff(y_range) * 0.08
  letter_data <- NULL

  if (nrow(df) >= 3L && dplyr::n_distinct(df$Treatment) > 1L) {
    cat("\n## ", ylab, " ANOVA - Line x N (numeric) x CO2 (N = ", nitrogen_label, ")\n\n", sep = "")
    fit_full <- aov(
      stats::reformulate("Line * Nitrogen_mM * CO2", response = trait_chr),
      data = df
    )
    print(summary(fit_full))

    cat("\n## ", ylab, " Tukey HSD - Line x Nitrogen x CO2 (three-way)\n\n", sep = "")
    fit_factor <- aov(
      stats::reformulate("Line * Nitrogen_f * CO2", response = trait_chr),
      data = df
    )
    fit_treatment <- aov(
      stats::reformulate("Treatment", response = trait_chr),
      data = df
    )
    print(TukeyHSD(fit_treatment))

    if (requireNamespace("emmeans", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("multcomp", quietly = TRUE)) {
      cat("\n## ", ylab, " Tukey letters - Line x Nitrogen x CO2 (three-way)\n\n", sep = "")
      emm_threeway <- emmeans::emmeans(fit_factor, ~ Line * Nitrogen_f * CO2)
      print(pairs(emm_threeway, adjust = "tukey"))

      y_pos <- df %>%
        group_by(Line, Nitrogen_f, CO2) %>%
        summarise(y_letter = max(.data[[trait_chr]], na.rm = TRUE) + y_offset, .groups = "drop")

      # Capture levels outside mutate(): emmeans tables include a `df` column.
      nitrogen_levels_f <- levels(df$Nitrogen_f)
      co2_levels_f <- levels(df$CO2)
      line_levels_f <- levels(df$Line)

      letter_data <- multcomp::cld(emm_threeway, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey") %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        mutate(
          .group = gsub("\\s+", "", .group),
          Nitrogen_f = factor(as.character(Nitrogen_f), levels = nitrogen_levels_f),
          CO2 = factor(as.character(CO2), levels = co2_levels_f),
          Line = factor(as.character(Line), levels = line_levels_f)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(Line, Nitrogen_f, CO2, .group) %>%
        left_join(y_pos, by = c("Line", "Nitrogen_f", "CO2"))
      print(letter_data)
    } else {
      cat("\n## ", ylab, " Tukey letters skipped - install emmeans and multcomp\n\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("\n## ", ylab, " Tukey HSD skipped - insufficient treatment groups\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Nitrogen_f, y = !!trait_quo, fill = CO2)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.65, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = CO2),
      position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, dodge.width = 0.75),
      size = 1.8,
      alpha = 0.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(vars(Line), labeller = line_facet_labeller) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = expression(CO[2]),
      values = c(AC = "cadetblue2", EC = "cadetblue4")
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = expression(CO[2]),
      values = c(AC = "cadetblue2", EC = "cadetblue4")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Nitrogen (mM)", y = ylab) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "plain"),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0, "pt"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  line_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$Line))
  left_facet <- data.frame(
    Line = factor(line_levels[1], levels = line_levels)
  )
  right_facet <- data.frame(
    Line = factor(line_levels[length(line_levels)], levels = line_levels)
  )

  p <- p +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(-Inf, Inf),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = left_facet,
      xintercept = -Inf,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = right_facet,
      xintercept = Inf,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )

  if (!is.null(letter_data)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_text(
        data = letter_data,
        aes(x = Nitrogen_f, y = y_letter, label = .group, group = CO2),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
        vjust = 0,
        size = 4,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      expand_limits(y = max(letter_data$y_letter, na.rm = TRUE) + y_offset)
  }

  return(p)
}
```

## Trait correlations within each line

Pearson correlations of Total Biomass, Shoot Total N, Nodule Count, Nodule Biomass, Shoot C/N Ratio, %Ndfa, Chlorophyll Content (SPAD), QY_max, Shoot Fixed N, and Shoot Soil N, calculated separately within A17 and within sunn.

```{r trait-correlations-by-line, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
trait_cor_cols <- c(
  "TotalBiomass_mg",
  "ShootTotalN_mg",
  "NodCount",
  "NoduleBiomass_mg",
  "ShootCN_ratio",
  "Ndfa_pct",
  "SPAD",
  "QY_max",
  "N_fixed_mg",
  "N_soil_uptake_mg"
)

trait_cor_labels <- c(
  TotalBiomass_mg = "Total Biomass",
  ShootTotalN_mg = "Shoot Total N",
  NodCount = "Nodule Count",
  NoduleBiomass_mg = "Nodule Biomass",
  ShootCN_ratio = "Shoot C/N Ratio",
  Ndfa_pct = "%Ndfa",
  SPAD = "Chlorophyll Content (SPAD)",
  QY_max = "QY_max",
  N_fixed_mg = "Shoot Fixed N",
  N_soil_uptake_mg = "Shoot Soil N"
)

df_trait_cor <- A17_sunn_phys %>%
  mutate(
    Line = factor(Line, levels = c("A17", "sunn")),
    CO2 = factor(CO2, levels = c("AC", "EC")),
    Nitrogen_mM = as.numeric(as.character(Nitrogen))
  ) %>%
  filter(Line %in% c("A17", "sunn"), !is.na(CO2), !is.na(Nitrogen_mM))

# Use one hierarchical clustering order across both line-specific panels.
trait_cor_matrix <- stats::cor(
  df_trait_cor[, trait_cor_cols],
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)
trait_cor_matrix[!is.finite(trait_cor_matrix)] <- 0
diag(trait_cor_matrix) <- 1

trait_cluster_order <- trait_cor_cols[
  stats::hclust(stats::as.dist(1 - trait_cor_matrix), method = "complete")$order
]
trait_cluster_label_order <- unname(trait_cor_labels[trait_cluster_order])

calc_trait_cor <- function(data, traits, method = "pearson") {
  pairs <- expand.grid(
    trait_x = traits,
    trait_y = traits,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    filter(trait_x != trait_y)

  cor_rows <- vector("list", nrow(pairs))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
    x_col <- pairs$trait_x[i]
    y_col <- pairs$trait_y[i]
    complete_idx <- stats::complete.cases(data[, c(x_col, y_col)])
    n_pair <- sum(complete_idx)

    if (
      n_pair >= 3 &&
      stats::sd(data[[x_col]][complete_idx], na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &&
      stats::sd(data[[y_col]][complete_idx], na.rm = TRUE) > 0
    ) {
      cor_test <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(
        data[[x_col]][complete_idx],
        data[[y_col]][complete_idx],
        method = method,
        exact = FALSE
      ))
      cor_rows[[i]] <- data.frame(
        trait_x = x_col,
        trait_y = y_col,
        r = unname(cor_test$estimate),
        p_value = cor_test$p.value,
        n = n_pair,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      cor_rows[[i]] <- data.frame(
        trait_x = x_col,
        trait_y = y_col,
        r = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        n = n_pair,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(cor_rows)
}

trait_cor_results <- df_trait_cor %>%
  group_by(Line) %>%
  group_modify(~ calc_trait_cor(.x, trait_cor_cols, method = "pearson")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Line) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_adj) ~ "Not tested",
      p_adj < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    trait_x_label = factor(
      trait_cor_labels[trait_x],
      levels = trait_cluster_label_order
    ),
    trait_y_label = factor(
      trait_cor_labels[trait_y],
      levels = rev(trait_cluster_label_order)
    ),
    cor_label = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.001 ~ paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r), "\n***"),
      !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.01 ~ paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r), "\n**"),
      !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05 ~ paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r), "\n*"),
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# Keep lower triangle only (unique pairs)
trait_cor_plot <- trait_cor_results %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(r),
    match(as.character(trait_y), trait_cluster_order) >
      match(as.character(trait_x), trait_cluster_order)
  )

print(trait_cor_plot %>%
  dplyr::select(Line, trait_x, trait_y, r, p_value, p_adj, n, significance))

plot_trait_cor_line <- function(line_name, plot_title) {
  ggplot(
    trait_cor_plot %>% filter(as.character(Line) == line_name),
    aes(x = trait_x_label, y = trait_y_label, fill = r)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = cor_label), size = 2.3, color = "black") +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      name = "Pearson r",
      low = "#5F8F9A",
      mid = "grey98",
      high = "burlywood3",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-1, 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = plot_title
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

trait_cor_A17_plot <- plot_trait_cor_line("A17", "A17 Trait Correlations")
trait_cor_sunn_plot <- plot_trait_cor_line("sunn", "sunn-1 Trait Correlations")

print(trait_cor_A17_plot)
print(trait_cor_sunn_plot)
```

## Fv/Fm light-response curve

```{r fvfm-light-curve, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
fvfm_light_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(6), function(light_step) {
  A17_sunn_phys %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Line,
      CO2,
      Nitrogen_mM = as.numeric(as.character(Nitrogen)),
      LightStep = light_step,
      PPFD = .data[[paste0("PAR", light_step)]],
      Fv_Fm = .data[[paste0("Fv.Fm_Lss", light_step)]]
    )
})) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Line %in% c("A17", "sunn"),
    Nitrogen_mM %in% c(2.5, 10, 20),
    !is.na(PPFD),
    !is.na(Fv_Fm)
  )

fvfm_light_summary <- fvfm_light_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Line, CO2, Nitrogen_mM, LightStep) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    PPFD = mean(PPFD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Fv_Fm = mean(Fv_Fm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    se_Fv_Fm = stats::sd(Fv_Fm, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Line = factor(Line, levels = c("A17", "sunn")),
    CO2 = factor(CO2, levels = c("AC", "EC")),
    Nitrogen_mM = factor(Nitrogen_mM, levels = sort(unique(Nitrogen_mM)))
  )

fvfm_light_curve <- ggplot(
  fvfm_light_summary,
  aes(
    x = PPFD,
    y = mean_Fv_Fm,
    color = Line,
    group = Line
  )
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 200,
    color = "orange",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_Fv_Fm - se_Fv_Fm,
      ymax = mean_Fv_Fm + se_Fv_Fm
    ),
    width = 10,
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    Nitrogen_mM ~ CO2,
    labeller = labeller(
      CO2 = c(AC = "Ambient CO2", EC = "Elevated CO2"),
      Nitrogen_mM = label_both
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(A17 = "#DEE757", sunn = "#F1B856"),
    labels = c(A17 = "A17", sunn = "sunn-1")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(PPFD~(mu*mol~m^{-2}~s^{-1})),
    y = "Fv'/Fm'",
    color = "Line"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(fvfm_light_curve)
```
